arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-plcodex-pr48-safe.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --depth 12 --branch hygiene/retire-obsolete-vps-ingress-20261030 https://github.com/martaxi-boss/Project-leader-codex.git "$tmp/repo"
cd "$tmp/repo"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 1c88ea706a145273b8e41798d1f147bc7e2719b8

python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,subprocess,json,re
expected={'README_CODEX.md':'32159b7425aec45a1fa2a8283528297f45d30fc22ab03b70d857e8b9c87968e2',
'codex/tests/test_coordination_contract.py':'5d64f483fbd7fda9e79dc200ff8bec84c6ce0673f1e47f1024bd54b127053b27'}
for name,digest in expected.items():
 got=hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 assert got==digest,('BLOB_MISMATCH',name,got,digest)
 print('REA_PUBLISHED_HASH_CONFIRMED',name,flush=True)
assert not Path('codex/owner_coordinator_ingress.py').exists()
assert not Path('codex/tests/test_owner_coordinator_ingress.py').exists()
base='1a7bc379c7d862cb1d30a4cd47d1a4d04249d1f8'
changed=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only',base,'HEAD'],text=True).splitlines()
want=set(expected)|{'codex/owner_coordinator_ingress.py','codex/tests/test_owner_coordinator_ingress.py'}
assert set(changed)==want,('CHANGED_PATHS',changed)
assert subprocess.run(['git','diff','--quiet',base,'HEAD','--','CODEX_COORDINATION.md']).returncode==0
from control.trusted_gate import verify_fast_path_against_base_policy
policy=json.loads(Path('projects/policies/project-leader.json').read_text())
verify_fast_path_against_base_policy(policy,changed)
print('FAST_E1_POLICY_PASS_AND_PROTECTED_FILES_UNTOUCHED',flush=True)
files=[Path(x) for x in subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','-z']).decode().split('\0') if x]
bad_json=[]
pattern=re.compile(r'(?:gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9_]{30,}|github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{30,}|sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{36,}|-----BEGIN (?:OPENSSH|RSA|EC|DSA) PRIVATE KEY-----)')
suspect=[]
for p in files:
 if not p.is_file() or p.stat().st_size>300000:continue
 if p.suffix=='.json':
  try:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
  except (ValueError,UnicodeError):bad_json.append(str(p))
 if p.suffix in ('.py','.md','.json','.yml','.yaml','.toml','.sh') and pattern.search(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8',errors='replace')):
  suspect.append(str(p))
print('JSON_INVALID_FILES',len(bad_json),bad_json[:10],flush=True)
print('TOKEN_PATTERN_SUSPECTS',len(suspect),suspect[:10],flush=True)
assert not bad_json and not suspect
PY
git diff --check HEAD~6 HEAD
echo PUBLISHED_DIFF_PASS

import subprocess,sys,os
for dir,name in [('codex/tests','CODEX'),('tests','CONTROL')]:
 r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','unittest','discover','-s',dir,'-p','test_*.py','-q'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=110,env={**os.environ,'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':'1'})
 lines=[x.strip() for x in (r.stderr+'\n'+r.stdout).splitlines() if x.strip()]
 summary=[x for x in lines if x.startswith(('Ran ','OK','FAILED','ERROR'))]
 print('REA_'+name+'_SUITE_EXIT',r.returncode,'RESULT',summary[-6:],flush=True)
 if r.returncode: print('FAILED_TAIL',lines[-16:],flush=True);sys.exit(r.returncode)
